title: Say it. Hear it backwards. Copy it.
pin_title: Reverse Your Voice Challenge: Backspin (Free Party Game App)
desc: Say a short line, hear it backwards, then try copying that sound. Backspin flips your attempt forwards and scores its sound, rhythm and length. Your first 10 scored rounds are free, with no ads or subscription. Now on Android.

title: A backwards voice game for game night
pin_title: Funny Party Game for Friends and Family: Backwards Voice Challenge
desc: Pass one phone around in party mode: everyone copies a line backwards and Backspin scores who sounds closest. Pick a daily challenge or play freestyle, then share a four-part clip of the funniest attempts. No account needed. Now on Android.
